sentences.text:
Order 
This appeal filed by the claimants under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of award dated 29/09/2012 passed by 10 Additional M.A.C.T., Gwalior in Claim Case No 87/2012 on account of inadequacy of the compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability is not in dispute, however, the finding recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard is not in question.
3. As per the finding of the Tribunal, in the case of death of Ramu Singh, the Tribunal awarded compensation of Rs. 5,86,000/- with interest from filing of petition till its realization.

4. Learned counsel for the appellants contends that the compensation as awarded by the Tribunal accepting earning of the deceased as Rs. 4000/- per month is inadequate looking to the fact that he was working as a labour.

However, accepting the earning as Rs 4525/- per month and adding future NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:16576 2 MA-1304-2012 prospects, applying adequate multiplier, the reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company contends that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation and argued in support of the findings recorded by the Tribunal.

Smt. Maya Devi vs Raghvendra Singh on 5 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14496681/
1 6.After hearing the learned counsel appearing for the parties and on perusal of the record, in the considered opinion of this Court, the income of the deceased assessed by the Tribunal for calculating the compensation amount is on lower side which deserves to be enhanced as under :-
 Monthly Income 4525X12  (Multiply age of deceased ) 54,300X18= 9,77,400  Personal Expenses of deceased  1/3 - 3,25,800/-= 6  Deduction  Future Prospects 40% 2  Consortium - 4  Funeral Expenses - 1  Loss of Estate - 1  Total 9
Tribunal awarded compensation
5  Enhanced compensation amount 4 7.
Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.9,89,240 /- as against the Award of the Claims Tribunal of Rs.5,86,000/-.
Accordingly, the appellants/claimants are entitled to an additional sum of Rs.4,03,240/- over and above the amount, which has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
8. With the aforesaid modification, compensation amount is enhanced to a sum of Rs. 4,03,240/ -.

The enhanced amount shall carry interest as fixed by the learned Claims Tribunal from the date of filing of claim petition till NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:16576 3 MA-1304-2012 its realization but he shall not get interest from 14/02/2014 to 09/09/2017 .
The said amount be paid within a period of three months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
Rest of conditions as imposed by learned Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.

9. If the enhanced amount of compensation is in excess to the valuation of appeal, the difference of the Court fee (if not already paid) shall be deposited by the appellants- claimants within a period of one month and proof thereof, shall be submitted before the Registry.
Thereafter, the Registry shall issue the certified copy of the order passed today.
10. This misc. appeal stands disposed of.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE Prachi Smt. Maya Devi vs Raghvendra Singh on 5 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14496681/
